title: Find a project
text:
What is a Quarto listing?
A listing builds navigation from document metadata or structured data. Instead of manually maintaining a collection of links, I define a content folder and let Quarto generate cards when the website is rendered. Adding a new QMD project to projects/ brings it into this collection after the next render. Quarto’s listing guide documents grid, table, and default layouts.

title: Find a project
text:
How this page works
The page uses this configuration:
listing:
  id: portfolio
  contents: projects
  type: grid
  fields: [title, description, date, categories]
  sort: "date desc"
  categories: true
  filter-ui: true
  sort-ui: true
  page-size: 6
contents selects the documents to include. type controls the layout; a grid suits a compact portfolio, while a table suits a larger index. fields controls the metadata displayed. The category, search, and sort controls help a visitor locate relevant work. The listing appears at the div whose ID matches portfolio.
A project document supplies metadata like this:
---
title: "Website usability research"
description: "A measurement plan for a clearer dining-information journey."
date: 2026-10-24
categories: [CEP, Customer research]
---
These dates identify portfolio entries, not dates on which a study was completed. I keep titles descriptive and summaries specific so readers can choose a project without first opening every document. Categories connect related skills across projects.

title: Find a project
section: Keep the portfolio useful over time
text:
Keep the portfolio useful over time
For a new project, add a QMD file with a unique title, accurate date, concise description, and consistent categories. Explain the business question, methods, evidence, and limitations in the body. Render the entire website, check the new card and its destination, and publish the updated output. Listings update at render time; they do not monitor the folder continuously on the published site.

About me
Through my work at Cal Poly Pomona, I am developing a foundation in survey research, SQL, BigQuery, R, and reproducible reporting with Quarto. In my Culminating Experience Project (CEP), I contribute to a digital marketing strategy for The Restaurant at Kellogg Ranch. My focus is website content, navigation, and usability: helping prospective guests find dining information and reach the reservation interface.

title: Style a Quarto website with CSS and SCSS
section: CSS and SCSS have different roles
text:
CSS and SCSS have different roles
CSS is the stylesheet language the browser reads. Selectors target HTML elements or classes, and declarations control properties such as spacing, color, and layout. SCSS is a Sass syntax that adds features such as variables and nesting. Quarto compiles SCSS into CSS during rendering. A browser does not load SCSS directly.








File
Role in this portfolio
Example




_quarto.yml
Connect shared theme and styles
theme: [cosmo, theme.scss]


theme.scss
Set Bootstrap variables and reusable rules
$primary: #164a46;


styles.css
Style page components and responsive behavior
.feature-grid

title: Style a Quarto website with CSS and SCSS
section: Connect the theme to the website
text:
Connect the theme to the website
The project configuration applies these settings to HTML pages. The dashboard declares the same theme explicitly in its own format settings.
format:
  html:
    theme: [cosmo, theme.scss]
    css: styles.css
The built-in theme is listed first, followed by the custom SCSS file. In Quarto’s theme pipeline, scss:defaults provides variables before Bootstrap is compiled, while scss:rules adds rules after the theme. This lets me change the palette consistently and then refine specific components. Quarto’s theming documentation explains these sections.

section: Use SCSS for reusable design choices

title: Style a Quarto website with CSS and SCSS
section: Use CSS for layout and small-screen behavior

title: Style a Quarto website with CSS and SCSS
text:
The cascade, specificity, and maintainability
When rules conflict, origin, importance, cascade layers, specificity, and source order affect which declaration wins. A class selector such as .demo-panel is more specific than an element selector such as div; among otherwise equivalent rules, the later one wins. I use component classes and shared variables instead of scattered inline styles or routine !important overrides. That makes later changes easier to trace.

A styled component in the rendered page
This panel demonstrates custom padding, a border, rounded corners, and a heading color. It remains ordinary text that can be selected and read by assistive technology.

title: Style a Quarto website with CSS and SCSS
section: Check the result from the reader’s perspective
text:
Check the result from the reader’s perspective
After changing a style, render the website and review navigation, headings, long text, and the dashboard. Check wide and narrow windows, keyboard focus, descriptive link text, image alternative text, and chart labels. Do not use color as the only indicator of status. Keep the QMD content semantic so the styling improves the reading experience rather than carrying its meaning.

My contribution
In the Group 9 CEP report, I am responsible for AO4, website content, navigation, and usability. The plan combines unassisted task-completion rates, median successful completion times, five-point ease ratings, and qualitative observations. Each task is compared with a proposed 80% completion target.

Approach
My earlier IBM 6500 portfolio brings together Introduction to SQL, Introduction to BigQuery, and Intermediate SQL learning notes and course-completion evidence. The examples connect database querying with marketing research questions.

title: Turn customer questions into database queries
text:
What this demonstrates
SQL provides a reproducible way to select relevant records, summarize observations, and connect related tables. Clear filters and denominators matter because a syntactically correct query can still answer the wrong business question. Before interpreting an aggregate, I need to understand the unit of analysis and check for duplicate rows and missing values.
